messages.subject: Project Tempest — Subscription Agreement (first draft)
messages.plaintextBody:
Oliver, Deepa,

Please find attached the first draft of the Series B Subscription and Shareholders' Agreement for your review, together with the draft Investor Rights Agreement and amended Articles to follow under separate cover. Key commercial terms track the term sheet. We look forward to your mark-up.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
